title: Beer-Braised Bratwurst with Sauerkraut and Potatoes
description: A hearty German dish featuring bratwurst, sauerkraut, and potatoes in a rich beer broth.
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
2. Add sliced onions and cook until caramelized, about 20 minutes.
3. Add bratwurst sausages and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
4. Add beer, sauerkraut, potatoes, caraway seeds, salt, and pepper.
5. Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
6. Braise for 30 minutes, or until potatoes are tender.
7. Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
